mapper.select: SELECT PAYMENT_NUMBER, MEDICAL_NUMBER, LINE_NO , PAYMENT_DETAIL_NAME, AMOUNT FROM PAYMENT_HISTORY WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} ORDER BY PAYMENT_NUMBER, LINE_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE receptionist_register SET receipt_status = '수납완료' WHERE medical_number = #{medicalNumber} AND RECEIPT_STATUS = '수납대기'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM receptionist_register WHERE medical_number = #{medicalNumber} AND receipt_status = '수납대기'

SELECT c.CODENAME_1 AS paymentDetailName , TO_CHAR(NVL(c.CONTRIBUTION, c.UNIT_PRICE)) AS amount FROM COMMONCODE c WHERE c.COMMONCODE = 'A' AND c.COMMONCODE_NUMBER = ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN 'A02' ELSE 'A01' END FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER rr2 WHERE rr2.MEMBER_NUMBER = ( SELECT MEMBER_NUMBER FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} ) ) UNION ALL
SELECT r.TREATMENT_ITEM_NAME , TO_CHAR(NVL(c.CONTRIBUTION, c.UNIT_PRICE)) FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS r JOIN COMMONCODE c ON c.COMMONCODE = 'P' AND c.CODENAME_1 = r.TREATMENT_ITEM_NAME WHERE r.MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND r.TREATMENT_STATUS = '치료완료'
UNION ALL
SELECT m.MEDICINE_NAME || ' 주사' AS paymentDetailName , TO_CHAR( NVL(NULLIF(m.CONTRIBUTION, 0), m.UNIT_COST) * TO_NUMBER(NVL(i.DOSAGE, '1')) ) AS amount FROM OUTPATIENTNURSE_INJECTION i JOIN MEDICINE m ON m.MEDICINE_CODE = i.MEDICINE_CODE WHERE i.MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND i.INJECTED_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT m.MEDICINE_NAME || ' (' || p.TOTAL_QTY || '개)' AS paymentDetailName , TO_CHAR( NVL(m.CONTRIBUTION, m.UNIT_COST) * NVL(p.TOTAL_QTY, 1) ) AS amount FROM DOCTOR_PRESCRIPTION p JOIN MEDICINE m ON m.MEDICINE_CODE = p.MEDICINE_CODE WHERE p.MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND p.PRESCRIPTION_STATUS = 'Y'
